title: UAP Disclosure Act eminent domain over privately held material
summary: Matthew Pines tells of UAP Disclosure Act eminent domain over privately held material, about 2023 at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: this is why the UP disclosure act explicitly targeted eminent domain right for things held in private hands

plain: A researcher named Matthew Pines says the UAP Disclosure Act, a 2023 bill in the US Congress about releasing records on UAP, the official term for UFOs, included eminent domain, the government's power to take private property. He says the bill aimed this power at material held in private hands, such as by companies. To Pines, this suggests the bill's authors believed such material exists outside government control.
